title: shows the folder a press answered after the engine has gone and come back
why: useDestination comparing the record with the folder shown rather than with the one last taken (issue 433, part c): the folder a press answered is put back to the record not yet read again, on the next render.

title: empties the typed fields when the engine’s tables drop the saved choice
why: useExportDrafts never emptying the drafts when the choice is dropped (issue 433, part c): the saved words stay in the fields of a choice that fell back.

title: keeps what is typed into a dropped choice’s fields after they were emptied
why: useExportDrafts emptying the drafts on every render while the choice is dropped, not once (issue 433, part c): nothing typed into a dropped choice is kept.

title: asks for the presets again, saying so, when the engine has gone and come back
why: useExportTables keeping the last engine's tables while it is away (issue 433, part c): the old tables' form is drawn when it is back, before the presets are asked again.

title: reads the outputs again when the destination changes, and not before (issue 563)
why: The destination dropped from the re-read's dependencies: a press on Choose folder or Use the app's folder reads nothing, and the line beside Export describes the old folder.

title: says what a second export replaces when the folder holds the file the plan named (issue 563)
why: The plan's file not handed to the run: the line beside Export is never drawn.
